parameters.name: AccessLines
parameters.description: The line codes of access regions.

parameters.name: DefaultAddrPoolId
parameters.description: The ID of the default address pool.

parameters.name: FailoverAddrPoolId
parameters.description:
The ID of the failover address pool.

If the failover address pool is not set, pass the **Empty** value.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the GTM instance for which you want to create an access policy.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description: The language used by the user.

parameters.name: StrategyName
parameters.description: The name of the access policy.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun alidns add-gtm-access-strategy --lang en --instance-id instance1 --strategy-name '访问策略测试' --default-addr-pool-id hrsix --failover-addr-pool-id hrsyw --access-lines default_,_drpeng --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun alidns AddGtmAccessStrategy --region cn-hangzhou --StrategyName '访问策略测试' --InstanceId instance1 --Lang en --AccessLines 'default_,_drpeng' --FailoverAddrPoolId hrsyw --DefaultAddrPoolId hrsix
